title: Validated Gene Expression Signatures of Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis
label_summary: IPF=17 sample rows from 11 patients; control=6
exclusion_or_admission_reason: Complete local GEO files were readable, but the official series describes idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis whole-lung tissue rather than peripheral blood and has no HC/MCI/AD endpoint; six patients contributed paired upper/lower-lobe samples, so it cannot be pooled with the MCI blood estimand

title: Blood Biomarkers for Memory: Towards Early Detection of Risk for Alzheimer Disease
label_summary: psychiatric diagnoses; quantitative HVLT memory phenotype; no standard MCI/HC stage labels
exclusion_or_admission_reason: Official SOFT design describes longitudinal within-subject psychiatric cohorts and short-term memory retention measured by the Hopkins Verbal Learning Test, with multiple psychiatric diagnoses; it is not a clean MCI-versus-HC stage endpoint and cannot be used for primary external validation

title: Overlapping AddNeuroMed-family FTD blood series

title: Overlapping AddNeuroMed-family dementia blood aggregate

title: Whole genome transcriptional analysis of Alzheimer's disease patients compared with age-matched non-demented controls

title: BCG vaccination CSF single-cell study in older adults
label_summary: longitudinal 0/3/12-month BCG program; exact diagnosis-to-sample mapping and participant overlap pending
exclusion_or_admission_reason: Linked to NCT04507126/NCT05004688 and PMID 42393277; CSF-only single-cell repeated measures with post-vaccination exposure and no verified HC comparator cannot validate a blood MCI-HC model or provide a performance estimate

title: Characterization of Global DNA Methylome in Mild Cognitive Impairment and Alzheimer's Disease
exclusion_or_admission_reason: Official GEO metadata identify an independent blood MCI/healthy-control/AD cohort, but the measurement is DNA methylation rather than mRNA expression. It cannot validate, tune, or be pooled with the whole-blood bulk-mRNA MCI-HC estimand; reserve only for separately preregistered cross-omics exploration.

title: Blood transcriptomic signatures link beta-amyloid deposition to molecular pathways across SCD, MCI, and dementia
input_specimen: PBMCs after peripheral-blood plasma removal and red-cell lysis
exclusion_or_admission_reason: The linked open article reports raw data at GSA-Human HRA019152, but its direct GSA-Human metadata page was not retrieved in this audit. More importantly, the assayed material is PBMC rather than unsorted whole blood, there is no cognitively healthy-control group, and the MCI contrast is Aβ-PET positive versus negative with n=8 per arm. It cannot validate, tune, calibrate, pool with, or supply a performance estimate for the MCI-versus-HC whole-blood mRNA estimand.

title: Functional role of SERPINA1 in trophoblasts
exclusion_or_admission_reason: A BMC Medicine article (PMCID PMC9422129) lists GSE165090 as an AddNeuroMed transcriptome dataset in its data-availability statement, but the official GEO accession viewer identifies GSE165090 as a public trophoblast SERPINA1 study. The accession is therefore unrelated to the MCI blood estimand and may not be used as a candidate cohort; this documents a source-verification failure mode rather than a biological result.
